skillFull: When you collect a certain number of Evidence Jellies, you will enter a courtroom. Once in the courtroom, a board will appear where you can submit the evidence collected. Adjust your jump according to the height of the boards and tap the button to attach the evidence. Once all boards have been attached with evidence, the judge will examine the evidence and make a ruling. The higher the level, the higher the Evidence Points and Verdict Points.
story:
From the Bear Jelly over consumption incident to the art theft at the Hors d'Oeuvre Museum, all the century's major criminal cases have been handled by none other than the veteran prosecutor, Cappuccino Cookie!

Though he's a veteran beyond doubt, he constantly mumbles about being tired. However, Cappuccino Cookie's commitment to justice remains unwavering, evident when he tirelessly stacks cappuccino-filled cups while interrogating suspects throughout the night.

Once the trials are over, he plans on going on vacation and this is why he wears a vacation shirt underneath his robe. But when will that day truly come?!

costumes.info: Under the blazing sun, this sunburnt Cookie is brimming with energy like never before! It's Cappuccino Cookie, and he is finally on the long-awaited vacation he has been dreaming of. Riding the waves, enjoying the cool waters, and when he gets tired, he returns to the beach to indulge in a refreshing nap. Be it at work or on vacation—Cappuccino Cookie remains fully committed to the present moment!
